item.title: The future of the Winter Olympics at risk as the planet warms
item.description: The Winter Olympics are nearing their end in Italy, but new research from Climate Central shows that climate change is putting the future of the Games at risk.

item.title: Mooresville Police Chief calls new drone technology 'game changing'
item.description: Mooresville's police department has deployed six drones to help track fleeing suspects, missing persons, and oversee crime scenes, while the ACLU expresses concerns about potential misuse of the technology.

item.title: York County Sheriff urging neighbors to donate towards Project Lifesavers program after second successful save
item.description: York County Sheriff's deputies in South Carolina used Project Lifesaver technology to find a missing 5-year-old autistic boy in 21 minutes. The program relies on donations and allows children and adults with cognitive disabilities to wear a battery-operated transmitter bracelet with a unique identifying number that emits a signal deputies can track.

item.title: Huntersville PD to have "heightened enforcement" at Birkdale Village after recent juvenile disturbance
item.description: Because Birkdale Village is private property, any policies such as age-based curfews are decisions made by property management and enforced by their security team.

item.title: Charlotte man enters Alford plea in Montgomery County court for the murder of Allisha Watts
